isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by manual UI upload or API ingestion[cite: 7]. Action: Ingest and deduplicate raw RFQ files across 22 project input file types (BOMs, mechanical PDF drawings, Gerber files, title blocks)[cite: 7]. Extract schema metadata into Cognee Knowledge Graph, map to Google OKF standard, and sync project record in CRM. Check: Verify ClamAV scan passed, content hash is unique, and Pydantic validation passes[cite: 1, 6, 7]. Bound: Max 3 retry passes on OCR failure before flagging unreadable input edge cases[cite: 1, 6, 7].

a_automation.action_step: Ingest via Uppy/tusd gateway, run ClamAV scan, trigger PaddleOCR for scanned PDFs, extract Google OKF graph nodes via Cognee, and bind CRM RFQ ID[cite: 1, 3, 7].
a_automation.acceptance_check: Programmatically evaluate: virus_status == 'CLEAN' AND pydantic_schema_valid == True AND crm_rfq_id_assigned == True[cite: 1, 6, 7].

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: Append to PostgreSQL 'rfq_input_standardization_audit_log' with Google OKF JSON payload[cite: 1, 6, 7].

ui_updates: Status: Ingesting Files -> Cognee Graph Built -> Awaiting Review Confirmation
alerts: PostHog metric logged for file ingestion latency; notify UI drawer of missing attributes
n_next.next_step: On human Action button press, fire completion hook to Skill 2 (Feature Extraction)[cite: 7].

steps.action: Receive raw RFQ package (BOM, mechanical drawings, Gerber files)
Scan and validate: virus scan, file type, size, content hash duplicate check
Build missing-details list and return immediate clarification flags to user
Create/sync CRM case record: RFQ ID, customer details, project promise date
Link ingested RFQ package to CRM case record
Identify each file type using Admin File-Type Master rules
Execute PaddleOCR on scanned PDF drawings and title blocks
Map parsed content into unified Pydantic schema and assign Google OKF metadata nodes
Human confirms normalized RFQ package before hook fires
